note: The structure the division rules produce, stated once for both tiers. api/src/services/divisions.service.js builds it on the server and tourganiser-ui/src/components/create/divisionPreview.js mirrors it in the client so the creation review can show pools and a bracket before anything is persisted. Each package asserts against this file and never against the other's code, so a change on either side turns its own suite red and names the input that broke. Plain JSON on purpose: neither package builds it. Positions are indices into the division's team list in seeded order; knockout groups hold rank placings, and a one-team group is a bye that generates no match. See docs/decisions.md, 'The Creation Review Computes Pools And Rounds In The Client'.
